_comment: Modular armor registry. Defines armor pieces, equipment slots ('helmet' | 'body' | 'necklace' | 'ring' | 'accessory'), weight classes ('light' | 'medium' | 'heavy' for true armor slots 'helmet' | 'body'; accessories/jewelry are pure stat items without weightClass), weights, flat HP bonuses, armor ratings, tiers ('starter' | 'mid' | 'void' | 'frost' for true armors), and per-item HP split ratio (default 50/50 across Main HP and Critical HP).

armors.name: Leather Cap
armors.description: A supple cap sewn from wolf pelts. Increases Max HP by 8 and Critical HP by 7.

armors.name: Padded Tunic
armors.description: A layered cloth and hide vest. Increases Max HP by 13 and Critical HP by 12.

armors.name: Reinforced Leather Helm
armors.description: A hardened leather cap reinforced with bone splints. Increases Max HP by 8 and Critical HP by 7.

armors.name: Leather Armor
armors.description: A stitched leather tunic reinforced with wolf hide. Increases Max HP by 13 and Critical HP by 12.

armors.name: Iron Greathelm
armors.description: A heavy iron helm forged to turn aside mortal blows. Increases Max HP by 8 and Critical HP by 7.

armors.name: Iron Plate Armor
armors.description: A dense cuirass of riveted iron plates. Increases Max HP by 13 and Critical HP by 12.

armors.name: Silk Cowl

armors.name: Silk Robe
